Details
  • Original code: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2 at a561b84
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
    • depth-anything-v2-b: CC-BY-NC-4.0
    • depth-anything-v2-l: CC-BY-NC-4.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2/blob/main/README.md (LICENSE section) and the Hugging Face model cards
  • Training data: Teacher (ViT-G) on 595K synthetic images (BlendedMVS, Hypersim, IRS, TartanAir, VKITTI 2); students on 62M pseudo-labelled real images (SA-1B, Open Images, BDD100K, Google Landmarks, ImageNet-21K, LSUN, Objects365, Places365) per the paper
  • Licence note: Only the Small weights are Apache-2.0; the Base and Large weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0. The training data of even the Small model has unclear commercial terms (a note only).
  • Options: short_side = 518 (>= 14; also input_size)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, dpt_fused
  • Variants: depth-anything-v2-s, depth-anything-v2-b, depth-anything-v2-l
  • Outputs: inverse_depth; kind: affine_invariant_inverse
  • Input size: any H x W >= 8, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 14)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): depth-anything-v2-s 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); depth-anything-v2-b 3000x4000 (0.8 GiB peak allocated, 0.9 reserved); depth-anything-v2-l 3000x4000 (1.8 GiB peak allocated, 2.2 reserved)
  • depth-anything-v2-s 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 16 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 30 s (ONNX + engine).
  • depth-anything-v2-s original 994x1482: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • depth-anything-v2-b original 994x1482: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • depth-anything-v2-l original 994x1482: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • depth-anything-v2-s load / first call: original 0.71 s / 0.38 s, portable 0.11 s / 0.027 s, kernels 0.08† s / 0.009 s
  • depth-anything-v2-b load / first call: original 3.94 s / 0.08 s, portable 0.85 s / 0.019 s, kernels 0.2† s / 0.012 s
  • depth-anything-v2-l load / first call: original 5.66 s / 0.149 s, portable 2.39 s / 0.081 s, kernels 0.91† s / 0.055 s
  • † measured in the speed sweep after the portable load (or an earlier size) in the same process: file cache and kernels are warm, so the time is lower than a fresh start.
  • Protocol, median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

Measured

AbsRel / delta1 after a least-squares scale + shift fit (in disparity space for inverse-depth models), mean over images. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
